description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
